figures.alt: Physical warehouse feasibility model with loading bays, blank plans, material sample, and calculator
figures.caption: A spec warehouse begins with a testable operating and site concept: users, clear height, docks, circulation, utilities, expansion, permitting, and the shell needed to support them.

figures.alt: Pre-engineered metal building erection with rigid steel frames, base plates, anchor bolts, purlins, bracing, and concrete foundations
figures.caption: Tilt-up and pre-engineered steel have different foundations, structure, schedule, envelope, and coordination requirements. The right system depends on the project rather than a generic preference.

figures.alt: Institutional warehouse with high clear height, ESFR sprinkler infrastructure, high-bay lighting, wide grid, and dock doors
figures.caption: ESFR planning affects the building section and operational capacity. Clear height, storage configuration, water service, structure, racks, and future tenant requirements need to be considered together.
